About Us

Lunovia Exports Pvt Ltd is a diversified export company from India dealing in high-quality agri products, spices, edible oils, textiles, minerals, tea, coffee, marine and eco-friendly products. We aim to deliver excellence and sustainability through every shipment.


Vision: Delivering India’s natural bounty worldwide with integrity and innovation.

Mission: To be a trusted partner for global buyers by ensuring quality, timely delivery, and ethical trade practices.

Why Choose Us? Rigorous quality control, certified standards, customized packaging, and strong farmer & supplier partnerships.

Fruits & Vegetables

2. Order Confirmation

Once you approve the quotation, we'll send a formal purchase order for confirmation. This includes payment terms, delivery schedules, and product specifications for your review and signature.

3. Quality Inspection

Our quality control team conducts thorough inspections at multiple stages: raw material selection, production process, and final product verification to ensure compliance with international standards.

4. Packaging & Labeling

Products are carefully packaged using export-grade materials with proper labeling that includes product details, handling instructions, and necessary certifications to meet destination country requirements.

5. Logistics & Documentation

We handle all export documentation including customs clearance, certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, and shipping documents to ensure smooth international transit.

6. Shipment Tracking

Track your shipment in real-time through our online portal. Receive regular updates about your cargo's location, estimated arrival time, and any relevant transit information.

7. After-Sales Support

Our commitment doesn't end with delivery. We provide comprehensive post-sale support including product handling guidance, documentation assistance, and prompt resolution of any concerns.

Certifications & Compliance

We are a certified exporter adhering to international trade standards. Below are the certificates and registrations that validate our compliance and quality.

IEC (Import Export Code)
Registered exporter code enabling international trade and customs clearance.
APEDA Registration
Assures agricultural export standards and market access for agri-products.
FIEO Membership
Membership with Federation of Indian Export Organisations for trade facilitation.
ISO Certificate
International standards for quality management and processes.
MSME / Startup India Registration
Recognition as a micro/small enterprise enabling various benefits and compliance.
FSSAI (Food Safety)
Food safety certification for handling and exporting food items.
Phytosanitary Certificate
Certifies plant health compliance for agricultural shipments.

Global Reach / Countries We Export To

We currently export to UAE, Saudi Arabia, UK, Singapore, and expanding to Europe and Africa.
